text: I don't usually write reviews, and I'm terrified of needles—I mean, really terrified. But it didn't hurt at all during the procedure. I recommend a female doctor.

Dr. Piak has over 30 years of dental experience. He is kind to his patients and is very charitable, giving free dental work to monks. The shop is very clean and has modern equipment. There is street parking.

The price is very expensive. Scaling is 1000 baht, fluoride is 500 baht.
But the bill came to 2000 baht. I was confused. I asked before the service and the staff said scaling would be around 1000 baht, so I went ahead with the service. Also, the sink looked very dirty. There were traces of rinsing residue from the previous customer that hadn't been properly cleaned.
The doctor was nice to talk to.

author_name: มัญชริน สาหลัง

text: Just dropping by to leave a review for the doctor. The clinic has been open for a long time, the doctor is skilled, and very gentle during injections. Highly recommend!
